ROOT = pathlib.Path('/home/administrator/projects/hexalith/folders')
WORK = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
E = ROOT / '_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence'
commands = []
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def run(cwd, *args):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True)
    commands.append(dict(cwd=str(cwd), command=list(args), exitCode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout.decode(), stderr=p.stderr.decode(), stdoutSha256=sha(p.stdout), stderrSha256=sha(p.stderr)))
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(commands[-1])
    return p.stdout
def dump(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n')
owner = json.loads((E/'story-1-17-owner-intake-2026-10-25.json').read_text())
with tarfile.open(E/owner['archive']['path']) as t:
    prior = json.load(t.extractfile('after.json'))['repositories']
    mapping = json.load(t.extractfile('ordinary-mapping-investigation.json'))
    dump(WORK/'prior-mapping.json', mapping)
full = {}; compact = {}; comparison = {}
for rel, old in prior.items():
    cwd = ROOT / rel
    head = run(cwd, 'git','rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
    branch = run(cwd,'git','branch','--show-current').decode().strip()
    status = run(cwd,'git','status','--short').decode()
    remotes = run(cwd,'git','remote','-v').decode()
    history = run(cwd,'git','log','-5','--format=%H %s').decode()
    entries = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage'],cwd=cwd)
    links = [x for x in entries.decode().splitlines() if x.startswith('160000')]
    files = {}
    for entry in entries.decode().splitlines():
        mode, oid, name = entry.split(' ',2); path = name.split('\t',1)[1]
        if mode != '160000':
            p = cwd / path
            files[path] = sha(p.read_bytes()) if p.is_file() else None
    nested = {line.split('\t',1)[1]:(cwd/line.split('\t',1)[1]/'.git').exists() for line in links} if rel != '.' else {}
    full[rel] = dict(revision=head,indexEntriesSha256=sha(entries),files=files,gitlinks=links,nestedGitMarkers=nested)
    compact[rel] = dict(revision=head,branch=branch,status=status,remotes=remotes,recentHistory=history,indexEntriesSha256=sha(entries),gitlinks=links,nestedGitMarkers=nested,trackedFileCount=len(files),trackedBytesManifestSha256=sha(json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True).encode()))
    changed = [dict(path=p,priorSha256=h,currentSha256=files.get(p)) for p,h in old['files'].items() if files.get(p)!=h]
    comparison[rel] = dict(priorRevision=old['revision'],currentRevision=head,priorIndexSha256=old['indexEntriesSha256'],currentIndexSha256=sha(entries),gitlinksChanged=old['gitlinks']!=links,nestedMarkersChanged=old['nestedGitMarkers']!=nested,changedPriorTrackedFiles=changed,newTrackedPaths=sorted(set(files)-set(old['files'])))
dump(WORK/'before-full.json', full)
dump(WORK/'current-state.json',dict(capturedAtUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),repositories=compact,comparisonWithOwnerIntake=comparison,commands=commands))
print(json.dumps({r:dict(revision=d['revision'],status=d['status'],priorChangedFiles=len(comparison[r]['changedPriorTrackedFiles'])) for r,d in compact.items()},indent=2))
